searchText: After couple of days thinking, I think this is an impossible task as the leaker can make a new zk circuit (and a new zk proof) that proves that some new set of data matches to the root hash without the users privatekey if you disregard that, you can initially allow everyone to make their own contract, and submit a hash of its to the chain, and when making proofs, you make a proof that says that the zk circuit is one of the hashes provided to the contract (but you dont tell which one) You would need a way to prove that your version of the contract is functionally identical to the other participant's version of the contract. Maybe original contract is mutually shared, then salted, then you generate a proof that your root is the shared contract plus salt? right, you can make zk proof of it in theory You would share the proof of "contract is just X + salt" off-chain, and after Alice, Bob, and Carol confirm they would mutually "start" the on-chain verifier (which would be inactive until all 3 had asserted that they have validated the proof). Pretty big "theory" here I think. 😬
